commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
90+7' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is yellow-carded.
90+7' Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera sees the trip by Yangel Herrera (Girona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Granada CF earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
